dedupe_keys.name: spatio temporal model results for battery electric truck charging demand in europe vesuvio

description: This dataset gives spatially and temporally resolved model results for the charging demand of battery-electric trucks in 30 European countries: the EU-27, Norway, Switzerland and the United Kingdom. It was generated with the Vehicle Energy Systems Utilizing Visualized Infrastructure Overlays (VESUVIO) framework for three market-diffusion scenarios (pessimistic, medium and optimistic) and five-year model steps from 2030 to 2050. Two data levels are released: detailed results on H3 hexagons at resolution 5 (cells of about 250 square kilometres) and a country-level key performance indicator file on charging energy, peak power, charging composition, spatial coverage and concentration. It was produced by researchers of the Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research ISI and published on 23 September 2026. Coverage is continental at hexagon and country level. The files are free on Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 (a 14 MB zip of depot slow-charging results and KPI tables in CSV and Excel). Caveats: these are scenario model results, and the hexagon archive released holds depot slow-charging results. The data support capacity planning of truck charging networks and grid connections, network flow studies of electric road freight and assessments of grid stress, and complement the European long-haul truck charging and Finnish truck charging datasets catalogued here.
name: Spatio-temporal model results for battery-electric truck charging demand in Europe (VESUVIO)
provider: Fraunhofer Institute for Systems and Innovation Research ISI (Patrick Plötz, Steffen Link, Daniel Speth)
